1 .  We have heard learned Counsel for the parties.
2. The challenge in this petition is to a land acquisition award dated 7 August 2023.

The contention of the petitioners is that they were entitled for compensation under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013, in respect of the acquisition of the said land of 30 ares acquired by respondent No.1 for development of the proposed DP road from Village Nilje to Village Hedutane, District Thane.

sentences.text: It appears that the award recognized the compensation being awarded in favour of respondent No.7.
Reply affidavit is placed on record.

sentences.text: 4. Today, learned Counsel for the petitioners and respondent No.7 are before 12 August, 2024 1WP12666-23.DOC
the Court to contend that the disputes between the parties in regard to apportionment of compensation are put to rest, in the parties arriving at consent terms.

In the consent terms, the parties have agreed for apportionment of the amount of compensation of Rs.6.69 crores as awarded under the award in terms of paragraphs 4(a)(i) and (ii) which read thus:-
4.

Whereas the Petitioners & Respondent No.7 hereby agrees to file consent terms before this Hon'ble Court in aforesaid Writ Petition to settle the dispute amicably and accordingly Petition be disposed off as under;
a.

In view of the amicable settlement of disputes and differences, the Respondent No.7 shall give his consent vide an affidavit/NOC or any other way as may be required for disbursement of the compensation amount of Rs.6.69 crores against the acquisition of the land S. No.38/7/A (old Gat No. 40/7) admeasuirng 30 Are at Village Nilje, Tal-Kalyan, Dist. Thane by the Respondent No.1 in the following manner;

i. Amount of Rs.2,70,00,000/- will be disburse in the saving bank Account of Petitioners.
ii. Remaining amount out of Rs.6.69 crore after deducting Rs.2,70,00,000/- alongwith interest accrued till date on compensation amount will be disburse in the saving bank account of the Respondent No.7.
5.
The parties have also settled the other pending disputes between them as seen from paragraphs 4(b) of the consent terms.
The consent terms are signed by petitioner Nos.1 to 4 on one hand and respondent No.7 on the other hand.
The signatories of the consent terms are stated to be present in the Court and are identified by their respective Advocates.
Advocates for the petitioners and respondent No.6 have also signed the consent terms.
There is no dispute on the signatures as made on the consent terms as stated by the Advocate appearing for the petitioners and Advocate for respondent No.7.
The consent terms are accordingly 12 August, 2024 1WP12666-23.DOC taken on record and marked "X" for identification.
6. We accept the plea as made by the petitioners and respondent No.7 that the petition be disposed of in terms of the consent terms.
The acceptance of the terms and conditions by respondent no.7 has been made by respondent No.7 - Shri.
Uttam Gana Patil in his affidavit dated 12 August 2024 tendered today and placed on record of the present proceedings.

The relevant contents of respondent no.7's affidavit are required to be noted which read thus:-
"3. I & the Petitioners have entered in to consent terms 29th July, 2024 and hereby declare that the disputes and differences between us have been reconciled/amicably settled and we have arrived at these consent terms.

The Respondent No.7 &
Petitioners are knowing each other since last many years and residing in the same village and having good relation with each other, therefore the Petitioners and I are entered into consent terms dated 29th July, 2024.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3 4. I say that I have no objection that the Consent Terms be taken on record and the amount of compensation alongwith interest will be disburse as per the Consent Terms dated 29th July, 2024.

5. I say that myself, my family members and relatives that we shall not file any further proceedings against Petitioners in respect of the subject matter of this Writ Petition and Consent Terms dated 29th July, 2024 and present Affidavit be it civil and/or criminal in nature after signing of the consent terms in respect of the subject matter of the present Writ Petition.

6. I hereby agree and undertook and acknowledge my presence before the this Hon'ble Court is mandatory for the purpose of settlement and undertakes that I will remain present for giving consent (Both Oral and Written) for settlement mentioned in Consent Terms dated 29th July, 2024.
7.
It is specifically agreed that there shall be no intentional delay in compliance of these Consent Terms.
I shall always abide by all the 12 August, 2024 1WP12666-23.DOC terms and conditions as specified in this consent Terms.
8. I have arrived at these Consent Terms without any force, threat, coercion, undue influence of whatsoever nature and declare that the same has been arrived at with my free will.

I have read each and every character, word, sentence, paragraph, page and have understood the meaning thereof and therefore both of them unconditionally undertake to abide by all the terms and conditions of these consent terms.

9. Save and except what is mentioned hereinabove there are no any other exchanges pending between the Parties."
7.
The petition is accordingly disposed of in terms of the consent terms.
8. The office is directed to issue a certified copy of the order passed by this Court as also the consent terms submitted by the parties.

9. Respondent No.1, with whom the amount of compensation is presently lying in view of the interim orders passed by this Court, shall accordingly disburse the amount within three weeks from the date the orders of this Court along with the certified copy of the consent terms are presented before him.
Learned AGP shall also inform the aforesaid order to the concerned officer.
10. Parties to act on the authenticated copy of this order.
11. Disposed of.
No costs.

(SOMASEKHAR SUNDARESAN, J.) (G. S. KULKARNI , J.) 12 August, 2024 Suresh Aambo Khutarkar And Ors vs Land And Revenue Management Mumbai ... on 12 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49080708/
